text.p: Demand in the flotation of a 35.6 percent stake in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel comfortably exceeds the available supply of shares, sources involved in the process said.
The public offer for sale (OPV) is three times oversubscribed and the domestic and international institutional sale is more than five times oversubscribed, the sources told Reuters.

Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais, one of two mobile phone operators in the domestic market, is offering a 35.6 percent stake of its 21.5 billion escudos capital, that is 7.645 million shares, at a price of between 6,900 and 8,100 escudos per share.
This stake could rise to 39.11 percent including a "green shoe" provision, whereby additional shares may be allocated to institutional investors if demand is very heavy.
The OPV, whose subscription period began today and which will take place in a special session on Lisbon bourse on December 9, includes the sale of 600,000 shares.
In the institutional sale of 7,045,000 shares, the allocation between the domestic and international sale has not yet been decided.
The bookbuilding period began on November 20 and continues until December 6.
